description: Absolute <base href="{{site}}/foo/"> + relative sheet href; the base directory URL itself answers 404 (only the sheet exists), and critical only accepts a base candidate that answers a HEAD.

thin.note: The new layer resolves the href against the base URL arithmetically and never needs the base directory URL to answer; critical fails the job with FileNotFoundError unless that directory URL returns 2xx.
